sources.entry: Suohai - Audio input/output source lock for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Suohai is a small macOS utility that locks the audio input and output source so the system does not switch devices automatically.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Suohai as an audio input/output source locking tool for macOS. The README is very short and does not list specific features beyond that core purpose. It says the app is installed by downloading the latest release and extracting it into the Applications folder. To build from source, it says to run pod install before building the project, which implies a CocoaPods-managed Xcode project. A screenshot placeholder appears but has no image. Credit is given to viko16.
use_cases: stop macOS switching audio output automatically
keep a fixed microphone or speaker selection
pin audio source on a Mac
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the repository's releases page
Extract the app into your Applications folder
To build from source: run pod install
Open the project and build it
stack: Objective-C or Swift (not stated in README)
notable: Locks audio input and output source on macOS
Distributed as a prebuilt release that is extracted into Applications
caveats: README is minimal and gives no detail on features, supported macOS versions, or usage
Source build requires running pod install first
